title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

This role focuses on post-sales deployment and optimization of Gigamon's network visibility solutions, ensuring positive business outcomes for customers. The Professional Services Engineer will join a collaborative, innovative team with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, system optimization, and quality delivery. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with cross-functional teams, system architects, and end-user technical teams. The environment values technical expertise, problem-solving, and security-driven thinking. This is a hybrid role based in São Paulo (extended area), Brazil, and will occasionally require on-site support at customer locations.

What you'll do:

  • Lead solution design, deployment, and optimization efforts for Gigamon's network visibility and security products.
  • Work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo, Brazil, providing occasional on-site deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization support at customer locations as needed.
  • Identify deployment alternatives and propose optimized solutions for customers across various industries, including mobile networks, service providers, and enterprises.
  • Conduct testing, documentation, and pilot deliveries to ensure high-quality deployment results.
  • Work with Gigamon and customer network visibility and security teams on policy compliance efforts in line with Gigamon standards, industry privacy and security regulations, and guidelines set forth by applicable country, federal, and local laws.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage existing and prospective network visibility solutions, reviewing relevant use cases, security policies, and procedures with business stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with system architects to ensure business systems and applications meet security requirements in preparation for end‐user review, actively participating and contributing to internal Gigamon reviews.
  • Collaborate with Gigamon and end‐user technical teams to ensure developed tools, systems, and applications meet appropriate security standards, policies, and procedures.

What you've done:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in the operational design and deployment of network management tools and applications in large-scale and/or virtualized networks, supporting mobile networks, service provider, enterprise, or government use cases.
  • Strong technical expertise in network protocols (TCP/IP, L2/L3, IPv4, IPv6), virtualization (VMware, Hyper‐V), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OpenStack).
  • Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) are highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, C) and working with APIs is a plus.
  • Proven experience leading technical initiatives without formal authority and collaborating with virtual teams across different geographies.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and cybersecurity standards (ISO 27001/27002, CIS, NIST) is highly desirable.

Who you are:

  • Fully bilingual professional (English and Portuguese) able to hold professional conversations smoothly
  • A proactive problem-solver who thrives under pressure and can effectively communicate complex technical concepts.
  • A team player with excellent interpersonal skills who can work cross-functionally and lead without formal authority.
  • Highly analytical with a deep understanding of network security principles and compliance standards.
  • Detail-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on emerging technologies.

Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Toroid - Toroid 4.0 | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

Vem impulsionar a inovação com a gente!

A modernização industrial é um dos grandes motores da competitividade no setor elétrico, e você pode ser protagonista dessa transformação. Estamos iniciando um programa estratégico focado na inovação em processos produtivos e no desenvolvimento de novos produtos na linha de transformadores toroidais e de média tensão — áreas essenciais para a expansão tecnológica da indústria.

O projeto busca integrar melhorias produtivas, otimização de fluxo fabril e criação de soluções avançadas para novos mercados, fortalecendo a presença da empresa no cenário nacional e global. Por isso, a atuação de um doutor especializado na área é fundamental: alguém capaz de liderar decisões técnicas complexas, orientar o desenvolvimento de protótipos, aplicar metodologias industriais de alto nível e guiar o estudo de expansão fabril com rigor científico e visão estratégica.

Se você tem perfil inovador, gosta de resolver desafios reais da indústria e deseja atuar em um ambiente onde pesquisa, tecnologia e impacto caminham juntos, essa oportunidade é para você!

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutor em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Implantação de Programa de Inovação em Processos e Desenvolvimento de Novos Produtos na Linha de Transformadores Toroidais e de média tensão.

Toroid Inova 4.0

Principais Atividades:

  • Diagnóstico e mapeamento de processos;
  • Modernização tecnológica; Estudo de expansão fabril;
  • Desenvolvimento de novos produtos P&D;
  • Prototipagem e validação.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Conhecimento técnico em processos;
  • Experiência em P&D;
  • Ferramentas de engenharia (CAD/CAE e simulação);
  • Gestão industrial

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Conhecimento em transformadores; metodologias de gestão e produção; indústria 4.0;
  • Expansão fabril;
  • Visão de mercado e conformidade;
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas de média tensão;

Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Idioma: Inglês – Intermediário

Formato de trabalho: Presencial

Local: São José dos Pinhais/PR

Soft Skills: Autogestão; Trabalho em equipe; Pensamento crítico; Criatividade; Organização.

Se você está pronto(a) para ajudar a revolucionar o mercado fitness e trabalhar em um time apaixonado, não deixe de se inscrever. Estamos ansiosos para te conhecer!

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. title: People Solutions Global Survey Strategy Lead
description:
Lockton is the world's largest privately held independent insurance brokerage and advisory firm, known for its entrepreneurial spirit, client-first mindset, and collaborative culture. Without outside shareholders, Lockton focuses entirely on delivering innovative solutions that help clients succeed.

In our People Solutions business, we partner with organizations to design benefits, total rewards, and workforce strategies that attract, retain, and engage top talent. From growing companies to global enterprises, we combine deep expertise with actionable insights to create solutions that truly support people and business goals.

Lockton is a great place to work because we value ownership, innovation, and growth. Associates are empowered to make an impact, share ideas, and develop their careers in a culture that emphasizes inclusion, collaboration, and excellence. At Lockton, you can do meaningful work, grow professionally, and be part of a team that genuinely cares about clients and colleagues alike.

The Role

We are seeking a senior leader to shape and execute the strategy, design, governance, and advanced analytics of survey programs that support client decision-making across People Solutions, including employee benefits, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation. This role focuses on translating complex people strategies and plan design considerations into structured, scalable, and data-driven insights for large and multinational employers.

The position requires deep expertise in employee benefits, total rewards, advanced survey methodology, applied social science judgment in question design, and senior leadership in automated analytics and insight generation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, execution, and governance of global and regional surveys supporting People Solutions priorities, leveraging enterprise survey platforms such as Qualtrics.
  • Establish and maintain methodological and technical standards to ensure data quality, consistency, confidentiality, scalability, and longitudinal comparability across clients and geographies.
  • Design and oversee automated survey workflows in Qualtrics, including complex logic, validation rules, versioning, and multi-country deployment.
  • Apply principles from social science, behavioral economics, and organizational psychology to design survey questions that elicit accurate, reliable, and decision-useful responses from senior HR, Total Rewards, Finance, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop survey frameworks that capture people strategy, benefits philosophy, workforce governance, and risk management practices while minimizing response bias and misinterpretation.
  • Design survey content addressing detailed plan provisions and non-cash compensation, including retirement programs, health and welfare benefits, equity-based compensation, deferred compensation, and other non-cash rewards.
  • Lead the development of scalable, automated analytics pipelines to process survey data, reduce manual intervention, and support repeatable benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Partner with analytics and technology teams to integrate Qualtrics outputs with data visualization, benchmarking, and reporting tools (e.g., dashboards and standardized executive reporting).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, translating automated survey outputs into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Present survey findings to executive audiences with clarity and credibility, supported by standardized and dynamic reporting.
  • Interpret survey data to identify market trends, emerging risks, and opportunities across industries and regions.
  • Partner with actuarial, legal, tax, rewards, and other People Solutions specialists to ensure technical accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Lockton's People Solutions survey and benchmarking capabilities through innovation, digital enablement, and analytics-led insights.
  • Provide executive-level oversight, coaching, and quality assurance for consulting and analytics teams involved in survey design, automation, and analysis.
  • Support business development efforts by shaping survey-led client solutions, proposals, and market-facing offerings.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Sociology, Organizational Behavior, Anthropology, Political Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in people strategy, total rewards, employee benefits, or human capital consulting, preferably within a large professional services or advisory firm.
  • Deep knowledge of People Solutions offerings, including employee benefits, total rewards, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation plan design.
  • Extensive experience designing and deploying surveys using Qualtrics, including advanced logic, governance controls, and global distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze survey results in an automated, scalable manner, supporting benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Proven experience applying social science or behavioral research principles to survey design, including question framing, response bias mitigation, and construct validity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence C-suite and senior client stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent).
  • Graduate or advanced study in organizational psychology, behavioral science, economics, sociology, public policy, human factors, or survey methodology, applied in a consulting or business context.
  • Experience integrating Qualtrics with analytics, BI, or data platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SQL-based environments).
  • Familiarity with governance, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to people programs and compensation.
  • Experience leading or scaling repeatable, productized survey and benchmarking solutions.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.

Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.

All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.

You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.

Job responsibilities:

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.

Key skills:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Python/React/GenAI) | Brazil (São Paulo, Rio areas)
description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams on demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world's largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

About the client

Our client is a leading global consulting firm that delivers transformation programs for companies worldwide. They develop internal tools and client-facing web applications using modern full-stack development and Generative AI, focusing on automation, smarter decision-making, and enhanced user experiences.

About the role

We're hiring Full-Stack Engineers (Python/React/GenAI) to join multiple production AI initiatives. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary consulting team to build scalable web applications and integrate GenAI capabilities into business workflows.

This role is a great fit for engineers who like owning features end-to-end, collaborating with stakeholders, and shipping in a fast-moving environment. It's also important to note: general full-stack experience alone isn't enough. You'll be expected to contribute both to new builds from scratch and to improving and expanding existing systems - including integrating GenAI features that will be used in production.

What success looks like:

  • Ship production-grade features end-to-end using Python (Django preferred) and React, including well-structured APIs and reliable deployments.
  • Deliver GenAI features in production (LLM interactions, workflow automation, data enrichment, RAG) with practical guardrails and evaluation.
  • Improve performance and maintainability by identifying bottlenecks, strengthening service boundaries, and contributing to CI/CD quality.
  • Collaborate effectively with distributed, cross-functional teams across multiple initiatives and geographies.
  • Communicate fluently in advanced English (written and spoken), since day-to-day collaboration and all project communication will be conducted in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Python (Django preferred; Flask/FastAPI acceptable).
  • Build responsive, maintainable front-end interfaces using React.
  • Integrate Generative AI capabilities into existing and new applications (e.g., LLM interactions, workflow automation, data enrichment, RAG).
  • Design and implement REST APIs that connect front-end, back-end, and AI services.
  • Assist in testing, debugging, and deployment using modern CI/CD practices.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Must have:

  • Experience of at least 4 years of experience in the domain.
  • Solid hands-on understanding of Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI or similar).
  • High level of front-end familiarity with React (production web apps).
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating GenAI solutions in production (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, LangChain, embeddings, vector DB, RAG).
  • Master the fundamentals of RESTful API/Service integration design.
  • Experience with databases: SQL and/or NoSQL.
  • Knowledge of cloud environments: AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of MLOps workflows (model evaluation, monitoring, prompt/versioning, deployment patterns).
  • Experience in consulting or enterprise settings.

Important to note:

  • Location: Brazil-based candidates ONLY (São Paulo & Rio areas)
  • Work model: Remote, with expected onsite visits a few times per month.
  • Type: Contract, 40h/week.
  • Duration: 6-12 months initially, with long-term engagement.
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship.

Why consider this opportunity?

  • You'll get access to Toptal's global network, including opportunities with Fortune 500 and other enterprise clients.
  • You'll have flexibility to choose projects that match your goals — part-time or full-time, short-term or long-term (based on matching and availability).
  • There's a potential path to direct employment with the client later.
  • The client may provide a Windows laptop.

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)

Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.

Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator, you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI). This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.

You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.

Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.

Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.

Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Administrative Specialist
description:
Administrative Specialist – Warehouse Operations

Guarulhos, SP – Rua Concretex, 800 – Cumbica (GLP II)

Work Model: 100% On-site

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an Administrative Specialist to play a key role in supporting a large-scale warehouse operation. This position combines hands-on execution and strategic thinking, acting as a direct partner to site leadership and ensuring operational excellence through strong governance, data analysis, and structured processes.

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy being close to the operation, working with data, managing critical contracts, and bringing structure, control, and efficiency to complex environments.

What You Will Do

  • Plan, monitor, and control preventive, corrective, and predictive building maintenance activities (civil works, HVAC, plumbing), ensuring safety, quality, operational continuity, and cost efficiency.
  • Structure, standardize, and document administrative and operational processes, ensuring clear workflows, ownership, and compliance with internal policies.
  • Act as a key reference for operational compliance and governance, supporting audits, internal controls, and risk mitigation.
  • Develop, track, and analyze performance indicators (KPIs), building dashboards and executive reports to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Manage large-scale cafeteria and shuttle service contracts, including budget control, SLA management, supplier performance, renewals, and negotiations.
  • Support budget planning and cost control, identifying opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement.
  • Provide strategic and operational support to site leadership, acting as a bridge between operations, suppliers, internal stakeholders, and corporate teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in a senior or specialist role within administrative, facilities, or operations environments.
  • Solid experience managing cafeteria and shuttle contracts in operations supporting 1,500+ employees.
  • Professional proficiency in English for meetings, reporting, and stakeholder interaction.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced Excel skills, experience with Forms, and the ability to prepare clear, objective executive-level presentations.
  • Experience working in highly structured environments with strong governance, compliance, and internal controls.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in logistics, warehouse, or industrial operations.
  • Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a large, complex, and fast-paced operation.
  • Act with high autonomy and direct exposure to leadership.
  • Make a real impact by improving efficiency, governance, and operational performance.
  • Work in a role that values ownership, analytical thinking, and execution.

  • Coordenar os times: Acionar os times técnicos e de suporte apropriados e garantir que todos estejam alinhados e trabalhando em conjunto para solucionar o incidente.
  • Garantir a comunicação: Fazer perguntas pertinentes para coletar informações essenciais para a resolução do problema e para preencher os controles internos e comunicados.
  • Conduzir a sala de crise: Atuar como "maestro" da sala, mantendo a organização e intervindo proativamente para propor escalonamentos ou acionamentos de outros times, caso a discussão não esteja progredindo.
  • Realizar escalonamentos: Fazer escalonamentos hierárquicos e funcionais de forma estratégica, no momento certo, se necessário.
  • Manter a sala ativa: Assegurar que a "war room" permaneça aberta até que a solução do problema seja implementada e validada.
  • Elaborar comunicados: Criar e atualizar comunicados de abertura, andamento e encerramento para manter as partes interessadas informadas.
  • Validar a solução: Garantir que o comunicado de encerramento seja validado em uma sala de gravação, assegurando que todas as informações estejam corretas e registradas.

Você precisa ter:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes
  • Possuir espanhol fluente

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM

Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate's education, experience, skills and potential.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
In SOTEC Consulting (Astek group) we are looking for a DevOps Engineer based in Brazil to join our client in the banking sector. In this role, you will work closely with DevOps and engineering teams located in London and Poland, while also being part of the early foundation of a growing DevOps team in Brazil.

We are seeking a mid-level FX DevOps Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to support and evolve infrastructure and delivery pipelines for foreign exchange (FX) trading platforms. This hybrid São Paulo–based role requires hands-on ownership of CI/CD, platform reliability, automation, and production support within a fast-paced financial services environment.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing systems end-to-end, prioritizing stability, change control, and operational risk while enabling rapid, reliable software delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tooling.
  • Administer and optimize Linux/Unix environments supporting production FX workloads.
  • Develop infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
  • Support containerized workloads deployed on Kubernetes or OpenShift clusters.
  • Create and maintain operational scripts (Bash, Python, or equivalent).
  • Collaborate with international engineering teams using Git-based workflows.
  • Monitor system health, troubleshoot production incidents, and ensure platform stability.
  • Participate in scheduled release rotations, including occasional weekend deployments.
  • Promote DevOps best practices including observability, automation, and reliability engineering.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years' experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or infrastructure automation roles.
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration expertise.
  • Practical experience writing and maintaining Ansible playbooks and roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Git collaborative workflows.
  • Proven experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience running production workloads in container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes/OpenShift).
  • Scripting proficiency in Bash, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Production support experience in high-availability environments.
  • English proficiency (B2+ spoken and written) for daily collaboration with global teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • AWS or other public cloud experience.
  • Exposure to bare-metal infrastructure environments.
  • ELK stack administration and observability tooling.
  • Dynatrace monitoring configuration and dashboarding.
  • Windows Server administration knowledge.
  • Experience within banking, financial services, or FX trading environments.
  • Familiarity with regulated environments and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working in Kanban or agile delivery teams.

Work Arrangement

  • Hybrid work model based in São Paulo.
  • Collaborative international team environment.
  • Opportunity to work on mission-critical FX trading infrastructure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Stable, automated, and resilient FX infrastructure.
  • Efficient deployment pipelines with reduced operational risk.
  • Strong collaboration across development, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
  • Continuous improvement mindset toward reliability, automation, and observability.

What We Offer

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise-scale DevOps systems
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers based in Europe
  • Exposure to modern DevOps tools and practices
  • Clear path to grow into a mid-level DevOps role
  • An international working environment with real business impact
  • The opportunity to help build and influence a new DevOps team in Brazil

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM).

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação."

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB).
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Senior Application Developer
description:

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud.

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services.
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development, including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards, including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications.
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval.
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph, or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services, especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research.
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: Comprador(a) Jr. - Obras e Mobiliário | Santo André
description:

Como a maior cooperativa de consumo da América Latina, valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, acreditando que diferentes experiências e perspectivas fortalecem nossa equipe e impulsionam nosso crescimento.

Prezamos pela excelência no atendimento aos nossos cooperados e pela eficiência em nossas operações, e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem desses valores e queiram contribuir para o sucesso da nossa cooperativa.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são abertas a Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente inclusivo e plural.

Sobre a vaga

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por apoiar os processos de compras relacionados a obras, reformas, mobiliário e comunicação visual, garantindo o atendimento às demandas internas com qualidade, prazo e custo adequado, sempre em conformidade com as políticas de compras e compliance da empresa.

Principais atribuições

• Realizar negociações nas categorias de obras, mobiliário, comunicação visual e energia;

• Analisar tecnicamente orçamentos e elaborar comparativos comerciais e técnicos;

• Apoiar o desenvolvimento da estratégia da categoria junto à gestão;

• Emitir pedidos de compra e acompanhar prazos de entrega e execução dos serviços;

• Garantir o cumprimento das políticas internas de compras, contratos e compliance;

• Desenvolver e homologar novos fornecedores, acompanhando indicadores de performance;

• Apoiar análises comparativas de propostas (preço, prazo, escopo e condições comerciais);

title: Executivo de Vendas - Key Account (F&B)
description:
Sobre a oportunidade:

Em expansão e com o apoio estratégico da consultoria Claire Joster, uma empresa líder no setor de embalagens para alimentos, busca um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas Sênior focado em Grandes Contas (Key Accounts). Você será o principal responsável por gerenciar uma carteira estratégica de clientes, maximizar a rentabilidade e fechar negócios complexos de alto valor, atuando como um parceiro consultivo de negócios.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão Estratégica de Grandes Contas (KAM): Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes estratégicos, garantindo sua satisfação, fidelização e expansão dentro da conta.
  • Vendas Consultivas de Alto Impacto: Identificar necessidades profundas dos clientes, contornar objeções técnicas/comerciais e oferecer soluções customizadas que agreguem valor real, lidando com negócios de alto volume e valor.
  • Planejamento Comercial: Definir estratégias, metas e planos de ação claros para cada conta, visando aumento de rentabilidade, análise da concorrência e antecipação de tendências de mercado.
  • Gestão de Pipeline e CRM: Manter o pipeline de oportunidades atualizado com precisão e utilizar o CRM (como Salesforce, SAP CRM ou similar) como ferramenta estratégica para gestão da carteira e previsão de vendas.
  • Negociação e Fechamento Complexo: Conduzir negociações de alto nível, estruturar propostas comerciais sofisticadas e fechar contratos estratégicos e de longo prazo.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas complexas B2B ou gestão de grandes contas (Key Account Management - KAM).
  • Diferencial altamente valorizado: Vivência no setor frigorífico, especialmente com embutidos, ou em indústrias de proteína animal.
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
  • Sólidas habilidades em comunicação, negociação e influência em alto nível.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e metodologias de planejamento comercial.
  • Inglês nível avançado (imprescindível para reuniões e relatórios).
  • Espanhol (diferencial para atendimento a contas regionais).

Perfil Desejado:

Profissional estratégico, analítico e com mentalidade consultiva. Capaz de atuar com autonomia, resolver problemas complexos e construir relações de confiança com executivos de grandes corporações. Orientado a resultados e com drive para fechar negócios desafiadores.

O que oferecemos:

  • Pacote atrativo de remuneração compatível com a senioridade da posição.
  • Plano de carreira e desenvolvimento.
  • Benefícios completos (VT/VR, Assistência Médica, Seguro de Vida, etc.).
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa líder, com portfólio inovador

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Business Development Manager
description:

At Excent Capital Ltd., we're building a high-performance, globally minded team.

We are a multi-regulated investment broker with international presence and offices in London, Seychelles, St. Vincent, Brazil, and our LATAM headquarters in Mexico City. Our mission is simple: to provide clients and investors with a secure, technology-driven platform to operate in global financial markets while creating real career opportunities for ambitious professionals.

The role is focused on business expansion, managing higher-impact opportunities, and driving results through strategic relationships and advanced execution.

The Role

  • As a Business Development Manager, you will be part of our commercial engine, working closely with our business partners and executing commercial strategies across LATAM, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.
  • If you have experience in sales, account management, or business development, and the ability to manage strategic relationships, close higher-value opportunities, and actively contribute to business expansion, this role is designed for you.

You will:

  • Prospect and generate leads across multiple regions and markets.
  • Develop and manage a portfolio of business partners.
  • Execute multichannel outbound outreach and conduct discovery calls.
  • Activate and onboard business partners.
  • Manage and update CRM information with discipline and accuracy.
  • Collaborate closely with business partners to drive business development.

What We're Looking For:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales or a commercial role, including prospecting, B2B sales, and client relationship management (full-time).
  • Graduates in business, finance, marketing, engineering, economics, or related fields.
  • Conversational english (Will be evaluated).
  • Experience in sales and business development.
  • Ambition, high energy, discipline, and a strong willingness to learn.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive net monthly salary.
  • Monthly commissions.
  • Clear career path for your professional growth.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonus
  • Working hours: Monday to Thursday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
  • Short Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.

Competitive package of superior benefits, including:

  • Health insurance
  • 22 days of time off per year
  • International business trips
  • Totalpass
  • Apple equipment
  • Parking at the building

On-site role Close by Berrini, São Paulo - SP.

If you already have experience in sales, are looking to take the next step in your career within an international company, and are eager to continue growing at a fast pace, we'd love to meet you.

title: Arrumador
description:
Apresentação do cargo:

Realizar a limpeza higienização e arrumação de apartamentos do hotel garantindo os padrões de qualidade e apresentação estabelecidos proporcionando ambientes impecáveis e acolhedores para os hóspedes.

Responsabilidades e atividades:

  • Limpar e organizar os quartos e suítes de acordo com os padrões estabelecidos pelo hotel, incluindo a troca de roupas de cama, higienização dos banheiros e reposição de itens de higiene pessoal;
  • Inspeção dos apartamentos antes da chegada dos hóspedes, verificando se tudo está em perfeitas condições;
  • Controle e reposição do enxoval como toalhas e lençóis, garantindo que estejam sempre em bom estado de conservação;
  • Relatar qualquer necessidade de manutenção nos quartos como lâmpadas queimadas, vazamentos ou móveis danificados;
  • Seguir rigorosamente os protocolos de higiene e segurança, assegurando a limpeza adequada e o manuseio correto dos produtos químicos;
  • Organizar pertences e objetos pessoais dos hóspedes com cuidado e respeito, mantendo a privacidade e seguindo os padrões do hotel;
  • Preparar o quarto para ocasiões especiais, pedidos românticos, aniversários, lua de mel, conforme orientação da liderança;
  • Zelar pela apresentação estética dos ambientes, incluindo arrumação de cortinas, posicionamento de almofadas, tapetes e decoração;
  • Recolher roupas para lavanderia quando solicitado pelo hóspede, preenchendo registros de controle;
  • Atender a solicitações imediatas dos hóspedes, como entrega extra de toalhas, travesseiros ou amenities;
  • Manter os carrinhos de serviço organizados e abastecidos com enxoval e materiais de limpeza antes e após cada turno;
  • Segregar adequadamente resíduos recicláveis e não recicláveis durante a limpeza dos apartamentos, seguindo as políticas de sustentabilidade do hotel;
  • Auxiliar no controle de inventário de materiais e produtos de limpeza, reportando necessidades de reposição;
  • Verificar a funcionalidade de equipamentos eletrônicos, TV ar-condicionado, cofres, telefones e reportar falhas;
  • Efetuar a lavagem de louças em apartamentos que possuírem cozinhas de apoio;
  • Controlar e repor os estoques das copas de apoio com os materiais necessários;
  • Enxovais papelaria produtos de higiene entre outros;
  • Montar e desmontar camas extras nos quartos conforme necessidade;
  • Outras atividades correlatas ao cargo.

Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 6 meses na área de limpeza, arrumação ou hotelaria

title: Supervisor de Compras Aeronáuticas
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Uma empresa de referência no setor de transporte aéreo, reconhecida pela excelência em atendimento. Com o apoio estratégico de Claire Joster, especialista em recrutamento, buscamos um profissional técnico para integrar nossa equipe de suprimentos e contribuir para operações de alta performance e segurança.

Objetivo da Posição

Liderar e supervisionar a equipe de compradores técnicos, gerenciando estratégias de aquisição de materiais, componentes e serviços críticos para operações aeronáuticas. Garantir a conformidade regulatória, otimizar custos e assegurar a continuidade das operações através de processos de suprimentos eficientes e resilientes.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Liderança de Equipe: Supervisionar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe de compradores técnicos, estabelecendo metas, realizando acompanhamento de performance e promovendo cultura de excelência.
  • Gestão Estratégica de Suprimentos: Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras para categorias críticas (peças de aeronaves, componentes, serviços de MRO, combustível, etc.).
  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Liderar o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos nacionais e internacionais, incluindo processos de homologação, avaliação de desempenho e desenvolvimento de parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Otimização de Custos: Elaborar e executar planos de redução de custos sem comprometer a qualidade, segurança ou conformidade regulatória.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Estruturar e administrar contratos complexos de fornecimento, garantindo cláusulas técnicas, comerciais e de compliance adequadas ao setor aéreo.
  • Conformidade e Riscos: Assegurar que todos os processos de compras atendam às regulamentações ANAC, FAA, EASA e normas internas de qualidade.
  • Planejamento de Demanda: Colaborar com áreas de Manutenção, Engenharia e Operações para planejar demandas de materiais críticos e evitar situações de AOG (Aircraft on Ground).
  • Indicadores e Relatórios: Desenvolver e monitorar KPIs de compras (lead time, custos, qualidade de fornecedores) e reportar à diretoria.
  • Processos e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de compras, implementando ferramentas e metodologias de gestão.
  • Gestão de Crises: Liderar a resposta a situações de emergência na cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo a continuidade operacional.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação: Bacharelado em Engenharia (Aeronáutica, Mecânica, Produção, Materiais ou correlatas).
  • Experiência Comprovada em funções de compras/suprimentos no setor de transporte aéreo ou aeroespacial.
  • Experiência Anterior em Liderança (supervisão ou coordenação de equipes técnicas).
  • Conhecimento avançado das regulamentações do setor (RBAC, ANAC, FAA, EASA).
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle) e ferramentas de análise de dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Habilidades avançadas em negociação estratégica e gestão de contratos complexos.
  • Inglês avançado para negociações internacionais e leitura de documentação técnica.
  • Perfil estratégico, analítico e com capacidade de gestão de múltiplas prioridades.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Suprimentos, Administração ou MBA.
  • Certificações em Supply Chain (CPIM, CSCP) ou Compras.
  • Experiência com processos de importação/exportação no setor aéreo.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas especializados (ILS, AeroXchange, PartsBase).
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação digital na área de compras.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas: capacidade de motivar, desenvolver e reter talentos.
  • Pensamento Estratégico: visão holística do negócio e capacidade de alinhar compras aos objetivos organizacionais.
  • Tomada de Decisão: assertividade para decidir em ambientes de alta pressão e complexidade.
  • Comunicação Influente: habilidade para comunicar-se com todos os níveis organizacionais e com fornecedores estratégicos.
  • Gestão de Conflitos: capacidade de mediar situações críticas entre áreas internas e fornecedores.
  • Orientação a Resultados: foco em entregas de impacto financeiro e operacional.

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição/alimentação

  • Possibilidade de participação em eventos e treinamentos do setor

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You'll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Atividades:

  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

We Offer

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Analítico Pl
description:
Venha fazer parte da Nação Azul!

Objetivo da posição: Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas para novos produtos e produtos já existentes no portfólio, utilizando técnicas analíticas de acordo com as legislações vigentes.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar análises físico-químicas, desenvolver e validar métodos analíticos, estudos de estabilidade, avaliar lotes pilotos e novas formulações, seguindo as Boas Práticas de Laboratório e em conformidade com as Legislações vigentes, através de técnicas analíticas como Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (CLAE/ UPLC), Cromatografia Gasosa (CG) e Headspace (CG- HS), Espectrômetro Ultravioleta e Visível (UV – VIS) para novos projetos e/ou adequação de portfólio;
  • Realizar pesquisa bibliográfica, através de busca em farmacopeias, revistas especializadas e artigos científicos;
  • Avaliar as monografias farmacopeias, verificando e documentando a sua adequabilidade;
  • Realizar e avaliar análises físico-químico em matérias-primas, produtos pilotos, produtos acabados, produtos em processo, água, preenchendo os registros de análise, laudos, solicitações de análise, registros de uso de equipamentos e logbooks;
  • Fazer o levantamento das necessidades de compras de materiais para o desenvolvimento dos estudos analíticos, realizando e levantamento de informações técnicas do produto junto aos fornecedores;
  • Orientar técnicos e estagiários em análises e Auxiliar analistas seniores e Pesquisadorno desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos para produtos terminados, matérias-primas, resíduos de limpeza, suporte de processos de controle da qualidade, validação de processos, validação de limpeza, estudos de estabilidade, desenvolvimento de produtos e outros, referenciando-se em normas locais regulatórias, corporativas, nacionais e internacionais para novos produtos e adequação de portfólio;
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais padrão, manuais técnicos, especificações de requerimento de usuário, especificações técnicas, especificações e métodos analíticos e outros documentos;
  • Elaborar e revisar protocolos e relatórios de validação conferindo os dados sequenciais para que seja de fácil entendimento e execução;

O que você precisa ter para fazer acontecer:

Ensino superior completo em Farmácia, Química ou Enga Química;

Mandatórios:

Atuação com HPLC;

Atuação com Validação de Métodos Analíticos.

Diferencias:

Pacote Office;

Inglês intermediário;
